definition: Deferred-interest or promo-APR expiry produces interest the holder did not expect (retroactive interest; expiry date misstated or hidden)
example_trigger: 0% for 12 months furniture/medical financing; return credit applied to wrong balance

definition: A fee the holder did not anticipate: annual/membership fee; minimum interest charge; draw or billing-cycle fee; cash-advance fee
example_trigger: annual fee on a card believed closed; $2 minimum interest charge on refunded balance

definition: APR or finance charge or instalment higher than understood: triple-digit APR; payment allocation keeping high-APR balance; payment jump; prepayment friction
example_trigger: cash-advance balance never paid down; instalment jumps from $61 to $590

definition: Late/returned-payment fees and interest triggered by a lender-side or system failure or a single slip
example_trigger: autopay fails on lender side then late fee + interest

definition: Payment debited but not credited or held for days; payment claimed rejected
example_trigger: every payment over $300 held; check 'not received' for a month

definition: Refund / credit balance / overpayment withheld
example_trigger: credit balance on closed account after account sold

definition: Autopay or scheduled payment debits the wrong amount / wrong account / twice / after closure
example_trigger: app hides scheduled payment so holder pays twice

definition: Account closed / frozen / restricted by the provider with little or no notice or reason
example_trigger: closed because of a linked family member's account

definition: Unilateral limit reduction (often utilisation and score damage)
example_trigger: limit cut with every payment

definition: Limit or balance capacity increased without the holder's consent
example_trigger: limit raised while a relative was misusing the card

definition: Cannot access / pay / close because identity re-verification fails
example_trigger: OTP only to a home-country phone while abroad

definition: Unable to cancel the product or an add-on or to close the account
example_trigger: closure needs a text code the holder cannot receive

definition: Unauthorised charges left with the holder; fraud claim denied
example_trigger: denied because 'chip read / PIN entered'

definition: Chargeback / dispute for goods or services denied or auto-closed
example_trigger: dispute closed because merchant gave no refund

definition: Credit opened in the holder's name without consent
example_trigger: ex-spouse opened card; BNPL account opened by fraudster

definition: Inaccurate or unfair reporting (late marks; wrong balance; duplicates; reporting during hardship or dispute)
example_trigger: hardship plan enrolment still reported 30-days-late

definition: Denied or blacklisted with opaque or legacy reasons
example_trigger: denied for 'insufficient credit activity'; past account with issuer

definition: Rewards / benefits forfeited / devalued / not credited
example_trigger: card benefit removed with notice buried in statement

definition: Mis-selling or wrong information at sale or from service staff
example_trigger: rep gives wrong promo-expiry date; product switched at application

definition: Insurance / protection / debt-cancellation add-on: unwanted enrolment or claim not paid
example_trigger: trip-cancellation claim stalled; payment-protection fees never opted into

definition: Forbearance or payment plan refused or mis-administered
example_trigger: Catch-Up plan amortised wrongly

definition: Payments mostly interest or fees; owes more than borrowed; loan flipping
example_trigger: $3300 paid on $1000 loan and still owes $1200

definition: Aggressive collection; debt sold or collected without validation
example_trigger: debt buyer cannot validate

definition: Unreachable support / contradictory information / bots / transfers
example_trigger: transferred between departments

definition: Personal data shared or used without consent
example_trigger: store-card data used for marketing

definition: Point-of-sale / BNPL / home-improvement loan where seller failed or was a scam but lender keeps collecting
example_trigger: solar installer bankrupt; pay-to-work scheme financed with BNPL

definition: Credit-repair or legal-theory template with no product-specific facts (exclude from signal)
example_trigger: 'I am now opting out of any and all authorizations...'
